description:
Check a Plant/Line/Cell/Equipment/Signal hierarchy: paths, sources, units and duplicates.
        Keeps the good signals and lists the bad rows. No network, no rights, no writes.
        Example: validate_asset_hierarchy(document={"version": 1, "signals": [{"path": "Milan/Line1/Cell2/Pump3/Flow", "source": "flow_meter", "unit": "l/min"}]}).

document.description: The asset hierarchy as JSON: {"version": 1, "signals": [{"path": "Plant/Line/Cell/Equipment/Signal", "source": node or tag, "unit": optional}]}.
document.title: Document

name: validate_asset_hierarchy
title: Validate an asset hierarchy
